That evening he lit the lamp early, as if guiding someone home who had been waiting far too long.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一个屏住呼吸的人。街灯还亮着，光晕里浮着薄薄的雾。偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过湿漉漉的柏油路，声音又近又远。便利店的灯是唯一醒着的眼睛，店员靠在柜台后打盹。送报的人骑着车，影子被拉得很长。写字楼黑着，像一排沉睡的巨兽。风从江面吹来，带着凉意和水汽。远处的天际线微微泛白，新的一天还没醒，旧的夜却已经累了。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny piece and asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- Like looking in two mirrors facing each other, each reflection shows another smaller reflection inside it.\n- It must always have a stopping point, or it would keep going forever and never finish."}
